name: owner-statement
title: Cloud cost allocation statement
for_each: select id,name from centres order by code

sections.title: Allocated costs
sections.sql: select month,currency,billed_amount,effective_amount from monthly_spend where centre_id=$1 order by month,currency

sections.title: Budget review
sections.sql: select month,currency,budget_amount,actual_amount,variance_amount,finding from budget_review where centre_id=$1 order by month,currency

sections.title: Investigations
sections.sql: select code,title,owner,due_on,status,evidence from actions where centre_id=$1 order by due_on
sections.note: Internal review document. Not an invoice or a claim of verified savings.

name: allocation-record
title: Account allocation record
for_each: select id,name from centres order by code

sections.title: Agreed share
sections.sql: select provider,account,weight_bps,reason,updated_at from allocations where centre_id=$1 order by provider,account
